thread:
maya-finops: Heads-up — I ran the weekly chargeback dry-run for April and the GPU spread looks off. Several infra teams are showing spend under `unknown` cost centers. Anyone seen this pattern?
john-platform: ugh, probably the new autoscaler instances not tagging properly after the autoscaler roll. saw something similar last month.
alex-eng: can you paste the grep? I can check the instance metadata plugin.
maya-finops: here's the short extract from billing CSV where unknown is popping up:
```
project,resource,zone,cost,cc_tag
redwood-prod,gpu-n1-us-east1,us-east1-b,528.40,unknown
redwood-research,gpu-n2-us-west1,us-west1-a,132.00,rr-research
redwood-mlbench,gpu-n1-eu,eu-west1,211.25,unknown
```
john-platform: thanks. looks like the GCE instance metadata agent failed to inject cc_tag on preemptible pools. we've got a hotfix but need a list of affected instance IDs to backfill.
maya-finops: Can we backfill and rerun the allocation script before Friday close? Finance needs corrected numbers for the monthly allocation to product teams.
sara-cfo: Friday is tight. If backfill is risky, can we mark these as "pending allocation" and apply a provisional split using last month's proportions? We need a conservative approach for forecasting.
ajex-typo: (typo)
alex-eng: yes — we can backfill tags from instance creation events in raw billing logs. I'll run a targeted job tonight against the last 30 days. If any records still missing, we can fallback to proportional split by team for the invoice.
costbot: Automated alert: 3 untagged GPU resources detected in project redwood-prod (estimated monthly run-rate $1.6k). See https://costs.internal/reports/1768054321
maya-finops: perfect. alex — ping me when the job starts. Also noting we should add an alert rule to avoid manual backfills every month.
alex-eng: will do. Proposed quick rule: when >$500/day untagged GPU spend, send pager to infra-owner + finops, and schedule auto-backfill job.
john-platform: agree. also adding a postmortem checklist item: ensure autoscaler plugin has a 5-minute retry loop for metadata writes.
sara-cfo: approve provisional workflow: 1) attempt backfill; 2) if >95% recovered, official numbers; 3) otherwise provisional split and flag in report. Finance to include note on CFO report.
maya-finops: copy. I'll prepare the provisional split and draft language for the report.
john-platform: started backfill job (job-id: backfill-176805). I'll update when done.
costbot: Job backfill-176805 started by john-platform at 2026-03-18T02:14:05Z.
john-platform: backfill finished — recovered 92% of untagged spend. I exported the mapping to /reports/finance/backfill-176805.csv and triggered the allocation script.
maya-finops: got the file, thanks. patching invoices now. final numbers look like this:
```
team,allocated_gpu_cost
infra,780.12
research,412.50
mlbench,679.03
```
sara-cfo: looks reasonable. please include a short note in the invoice: "3 resources initially untagged; allocation finalized after backfill; see internal ticket FIN-784."
maya-finops: added note and sent provisional invoice to the teams. tagging FIN-784 for follow-up.
john-platform: I'll push the autoscaler metadata retry and add the alert rule. ETA tomorrow morning.
maya-finops: appreciated. moving this to resolved for now but will reopen if finance sees anomalies in next cycle. :thumbsup:
